docs.description: The checked values, as a JSON array. A new value from the server replaces it; the live value is the value property.
Choices from the server: ["A", "B"] or [{value, label, description?, disabled?}]. <sb-check> children win over it.
Visible label, and the accessible name of the group.
Show a leading checkbox that checks or clears every enabled choice, labelled with this text ("All" when empty).
Stack the choices or lay them out in a row.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local value differs from the server's value attribute (see revert()).
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command), and the field each checked choice submits in a form.

slots.description: <sb-check value="…" [description] [disabled]>Label</sb-check> items: markup the group reads as its choices, like <option> in a native <select>. Nothing is slotted; the group renders the items itself.

events.name: change
events.description: When the user checks or clears a choice (or all of them).

events.name: sb-change
events.description: Same moment. detail: { name, value } (value is the array of checked values): ready for a command.
